evidence.reason: The current dependency regex omits the systemd [Unit] stop-propagation directives StopPropagatedFrom= and PropagatesStopTo=. A co-installed unit that references a selected crq unit through either directive can be stopped when the selected/fenced unit is stopped, so the dependency scan's foreign-dependency rejection is bypassed. Adding both names to DEPENDENCY_RE is the smallest correct fix; no contract clause or owner decision is needed for this ordinary correctness repair.
